description: Estadística anual de ciclones tropicales is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Marina (SEMAR). Estadística meteorológica referente a los ciclones tropicales que ingresaron a aguas mexicanas. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Marina (SEMAR). Its tags are ciclón, ciclón tropical, clima, clima tropical, control meteorológico. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-04-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
